findings.message: The manifest declares three events (pr.delivery.blocked, pr.delivery.opened, pr.delivery.dry_run) under provides.events — which ADR-001 defines as events the plugin actually emits — but the plugin never emits any of them; the only emit_event call (line 248) fires plugin.result, not pr.delivery.blocked, leaving every monitoring, alerting, or audit trail wired to pr.delivery.* permanently dark.

stage_signal_begin is installed at line 133, after both the block-guard (lines 106-120) and dry-run path (lines 123-130); a SIGTERM arriving while jq reads the review_report or gate artifact in the block-guard section leaves no pr-result.json on disk — the unguarded window is narrower than before the change (previously the entire function was unprotected) but is non-zero because jq performs file I/O.

draft appears at the v2 result top level AND nested under data.draft in _pr_delivery_write_result; ADR-054 §4 defines the envelope as {result_contract, verdict, disposition, reason, data} with plugin-specific detail under data, so the top-level draft field is outside the declared schema — confirmed by the updated golden which also carries draft twice.

The updated golden removes data.pr_number, data.issue, and data.status from pr-result.json (fields previously written by pr-open and now replaced by pr-delivery's own v2 result); any reporting, summary, or downstream tooling that reads data.pr_number from this artifact will silently receive empty — rollback to v1 restores the old fields, so recovery is straightforward.
